sections.Profile:
The "Doctor Who" pinball machine by Bally, released in 1992, is a fan favorite designed by Barry Oursler. The game features the first seven Doctors from the iconic British TV series, each associated with different playfield scoring features that can be selected by the player. The centerpiece of the game is the Time Expander, a moving mechanism that challenges players to lock balls and hit various targets to initiate multiball.
